name: Tásmam Koyóm (Humbug Valley)
description: 2,325-acre montane meadow valley in Plumas County, ancestral Mountain Maidu land returned to the Maidu Summit Consortium in 2019. Burned in the 2021 Dixie Fire; site of CDFW's first beaver conservation release in ~75 years (Oct 2023), following process-based restoration work.

events.label: Land returned to Maidu Summit Consortium

notes: Center coordinates provided by the user (site contact). Elevation ~1,370 m: expect snow-covered Q1/Q4 frames. Beavers built a 328-ft dam; CDFW reported +22% water coverage by April 2025.
